The '''Worker's Militia''' was an [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid]] terrorist group based in the [[Alagon system/Legends|Alagon system]].

==History==
The Worker's Militia was formed when the [[Xeran Mining Corporation]] laid off all the workers and replaced them with [[HND-9 mining droid]]s. The disgruntled workers started sabotaging the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], which led the corporation to evict the miners from the company owned housing.

The Militia retaliated by reprogramming the droids to attack out-bound [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] that were hauling [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. The corporation then hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to hunt down the leaders of the Militia and put an end to the uprising.

The conflict was settled when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent forces to the [[Alagon system/Legends|Alagon system]].
